Description
Dublin City University (DCU) is a public higher education institution in Ireland. Dublin City University is one of the top 3 universities in Ireland and has also been named numerous times as one of the world's top 50 universities that are under 50 years old by the QS World University Rankings list. DCU's QS World University ranking is 391st (jointly) for 2018 and it is ranked in the 51-60 bracket among universities less than 50 years old. Dublin is a fantastic city to study with a vibrant nightlife and excellent career prospects.
